title: Explicit construction of spherical $5$- and $7$-designs
summary: This paper develops an explicit and implementable framework for constructing spherical designs by lifting point sets from tight fusion frames. By combining existing ingredients, we obtain, in every dimension, explicit spherical $5$-designs with $|X|=\mathcal{O}(d^3)$. As a core component of the method, we give an explicit construction of simplex $3$-designs realized as orbits of the symmetric group.
